items.title: Hal Espinosa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 20, 2024
items.q: So I replaced him on Maynard’s band.

ctx.x: That’s high pressure for sure. And I can just picture the contractor like putting a check by someone who made an error. Take him off the list.

Oh I know. It’s that easy. I mean you have to really be on the ball and if you aren’t then you’re gone a lot of times unless you’re really close to the contractor. And you know there are times, and you can cut this out of the thing if you want, but there were times back in the early days when guys would have these little vials of cocaine and during breaks take the contractor out and then come back and they’d always make sure that guy was in their next job. And you know it’s kind of political. I hate to say it but…

It’s interesting, I think technology in one respect has been helpful for that kind of thing because you’ve experienced those — except for riding in the Corvette — the endless hours sidemen talk about being on the bus with basically nothing to do. And with the advent of Walkmans and now the phones and everything, people can fill their time with something else that’s not a health risk.
